title: A proven leader in AI innovation and data modernization
summary: EXL is recognized as a leader in Everest Group's 2025 Data and AI Services Specialists PEAK Matrix Assessment.
body_markdown:
# A proven leader in AI innovation and data modernization ## EXL recognized as a leader in Everest Group Data and AI Services Specialists North America PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2025 [Download report](https://www.exlservice.com/insights/reports-research/a-proven-leader-in-ai-innovation-and-data-modernization#nxt-exl-form) ### About the report EXL has once again been recognized as a Leader in the[Everest Group Data and AI Services Specialists](https://www.exlservice.com/about/newsroom/exl-named-leader-everest-group-data-and-ai-services-specialists-peak-matrixr-assessment-2025) – North America PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2025. The assessment evaluated 32 top data and AI providers on their ability to meet enterprise needs and deliver scalable, secure, and high-impact solutions. This recognition highlights EXL’s differentiated approach to building industry-specific AI ecosystems—combining proprietary IP with deep domain expertise to deliver real-world business outcomes ### According to Everest Group: “EXL has invested in advancing its Data and AI capabilities, with an emphasis on domain-specific applications across insurance, healthcare, and retail,” says Vishal Gupta, Partner at Everest Group. “This is reflected in solutions such as EXL Claims Assist, which leverages gen AI to streamline insurance claims processing. Its growing IP portfolio, including platforms like XTRAKTO.AI™ for intelligent document processing and Code Harbor for AI-assisted code generation, enables faster implementation and greater operational efficiency. In addition, its collaboration with NVIDIA, leveraging platforms such as NeMo and AI Enterprise to power offerings such as EXL Insurance LLM™ and Smart Agent Assist, strengthens its ability to build and scale high-performance AI solutions. These efforts have contributed to EXL’s positioning as a Leader in Everest Group’s Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Services Specialists PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2025.” ### Key findings #### Based on an in-depth analysis of 32 leading service providers, the report highlights EXL’s: 01

Accelerated Time-to-Value Through Proprietary IP: Solutions like XTRAKTO.AI™, EXL Insurance LLM, Smart Agent Assist, and Code Harbor are designed to shorten deployment timelines and drive fast, measurable outcomes.

02

Real-World Results, Not Just Pilots: Clients cite EXL’s ability to move AI from concept to scaled production, with structured delivery governance and high adaptability enabling rapid transformation.

03

Industry-Driven Design: With AI solutions tailored to specific industry workflows, EXL helps clients embed intelligence into core operations—from claims and underwriting to collections and care management.

04

Strong Ecosystem Partnerships: Collaborations with NVIDIA, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud power next-gen performance and scalability across enterprise-grade AI implementations.

05

Sustainable, Trust-Based Engagements: EXL’s collaborative model and alignment to evolving business goals foster long-term partnerships—not just point-in-time projects.

## AI That Drives Outcomes Enterprises that work with EXL report making better decisions, incurring lower costs, and achieving faster transformation. The Everest Group recognition confirms EXL’s role as a strategic partner delivering enterprise AI that works in the real world—not just in theory.
